## Overview

An interactive Shiny application developed as part of a Master 2 course at Agrocampus Ouest. This dashboard visualizes suicide counts and rates across countries, allowing exploration by year, sex, age group, and generation.

## Features

### 📍 Interactive World Map
Explore global suicide rates with an interactive Leaflet map. Select different years to see how rates change over time. Countries are color-coded based on suicide rates per 100,000 inhabitants.

### 📈 Time Series Analysis
Analyze suicide trends over time with interactive Plotly charts:
- **Global trends**: Overall suicide rates across all countries
- **By sex**: Compare patterns between male and female populations
- **By age**: Examine differences across age groups (5-14, 15-24, 25-34, 35-54, 55-74, 75+)
- **By generation**: Analyze generational patterns (G.I. Generation, Silent, Boomers, Gen X, Millennials, Gen Z)

### 🏆 Country Rankings
Compare countries using customizable metrics:
- Filter by time period (1990-2014)
- Choose between suicide rates or absolute counts
- View top and bottom ranked countries
- Download filtered data for further analysis

### 📊 Raw Data Explorer
Browse and search the complete dataset with an interactive data table supporting sorting, filtering, and pagination.

## Technologies Used

- **R Shiny**: Interactive web application framework
- **Leaflet**: Interactive mapping library
- **Plotly**: Interactive, publication-quality charts
- **Tidyverse**: Data manipulation and visualization
- **sf**: Spatial data handling and geospatial analysis
- **shinythemes & shinyWidgets**: Enhanced UI components

## About the Data

The dataset covers suicide statistics from **1985 to 2016** across multiple countries with the following dimensions:

- **Geographic coverage**: 100+ countries with latitude/longitude coordinates
- **Time period**: 1985-2016 (31 years)
- **Demographics**: 
  - Sex: Male, Female
  - Age groups: 6 categories from 5-14 years to 75+ years
  - Generations: 6 generational cohorts
- **Metrics**: 
  - Absolute suicide counts
  - Suicide rates per 100,000 inhabitants
  - Population data for rate calculations

### Data Source

Data sourced from Kaggle's [Suicide Rates Overview 1985 to 2016](https://www.kaggle.com/russellyates88/suicide-rates-overview-1985-to-2016) dataset, compiled from United Nations Development Program, World Bank, Kaggle, and World Health Organization sources.

### Limitations

- Missing data for several countries and time periods
- Economic and social indicators not included in this dataset
- Data quality varies by country and reporting period

## Technical Implementation

### App Structure

The application follows Shiny best practices with modular code organization:

```
shinyappM2Proj/
├── app.R              # App launcher
├── global.R           # Load libraries and data
├── ui.R               # User interface definition
├── server.R           # Server logic and reactive functions
├── data_management.R  # Data loading and preprocessing
├── setup.R            # Package installation script
└── data/
    └── suicide_coord.csv  # Main dataset
```

### Key R Packages

- `shiny` (1.8.0+): Web application framework
- `leaflet`: Interactive maps
- `plotly`: Interactive charts
- `tidyverse`: Data manipulation (`dplyr`, `ggplot2`, `readr`)
- `sf`: Spatial data handling
- `mapview`: Map export functionality

### Deployment

Hosted on [shinyapps.io](https://www.shinyapps.io/) - Posit's platform for deploying Shiny applications. The free tier provides:
- 5 active applications
- 25 active hours per month
- Automatic sleep after 15 minutes of inactivity
